source.label: Bob's Guide to Royal Flush Deluxe

supportingSources.label: Kineticist Royal Flush Deluxe machine guide
Bob's Guide to Royal Flush and Card Whiz

strategy.summary: Use the right flipper to repeat the far-left white lane for 30,000 and upper-playfield access. Complete useful drops when they are presented, but never shoot the center 3,000 pad as a primary objective.

quickInfo.name: Far-left white lane
quickInfo.summary: The left half-orbit scores 30,000 and is the game's safest repeatable scoring route.

quickInfo.name: Right flipper
quickInfo.summary: The right flipper has the preferred angle for the far-left lane and is the go-to flipper.

quickInfo.name: Nine-card bank
quickInfo.summary: The drop targets build the card-hand bonus, but their rebounds are less predictable than the orbit route.

quickInfo.name: Joker lanes
quickInfo.summary: The far-left route returns the ball toward the upper Joker lanes and can advance the shared Royal Flush features incidentally.

quickInfo.name: Center pad
quickInfo.summary: The exposed pad behind the completed bank remains only 3,000 and is not worth a deliberate shot.

steps.text: Plunge toward a needed upper-left Joker lane when the feed can be marked.
Let a controlled left-flipper ball cross to the right flipper when the transfer is safe.
From the right flipper, shoot the far-left white lane for 30,000.
Read the upper return and collect missing Joker lanes without forcing a nudge.
Repeat the far-left lane while its lower-rubber return remains controlled.
Take a nearly completed drop-target set only when the rebound has shown a safe path.
After the drop bank is down, ignore the center 3,000 pad.
Return every controlled right-flipper ball to the 30,000 left lane.

fallback.title: Recovery: Safe upper drops
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this plan when the far-left lane is not makeable or its return is dangerous.

steps.text: Stop the orbit repeat after a return reaches a slingshot, outlane, or center.
Choose an upper card drop that completes or materially advances a card set.
Shoot from the flipper that gives the target a glancing angle.
Regain control before taking another target.
Return to the left orbit if its feed becomes reliable again.

alternatives.title: Position play: Open the right outlane gate
alternatives.when: When ahead, use this distinct scoreboard route: use this plan when the right white lane is lit and reachable without a direct lower-target shot.

steps.text: Confirm that the right-side Open Gate lane is lit.
Use a natural upper-playfield feed or safe rebound to enter the lane.
Verify that the gate opens before relying on the right-outlane save.
Resume the far-left 30,000 lane route.

alternatives.title: Finish a nearby card hand
alternatives.when: Use this plan when one exposed drop completes a displayed hand bonus.

steps.text: Read the remaining cards before shooting.
Take the single upper card drop that completes the hand when possible.
Avoid the lower-left targets unless their return has proved controllable.
Return to the 30,000 lane after the completion.
Repeat the far-left white lane for 30,000 per successful pass.
Use its upper return to collect useful Joker lanes.
Complete safe portions of the nine-card drop bank when presented.
Protect the resulting end-of-ball card bonus.
Never trade an orbit opportunity for the center 3,000 pad.

techniques.name: Right-flipper left orbit
techniques.instruction: Settle the ball on the right flipper and shoot the far-left white lane. Repeat only after confirming the upper and lower return paths.

techniques.name: Correct-side target shot
techniques.instruction: Choose the flipper that gives a needed drop target the more glancing rebound. Favor the upper card drops over the lower-left targets.

techniques.name: Upper-return read
techniques.instruction: Track the ball through the Joker area and prepare for its exit on the right side before setting up another orbit shot.

cautions.issue: Balls exiting the upper playfield on the right can drain.
cautions.response: Track the exit past the slanted rubber and prepare both flippers instead of assuming the ball will return cleanly.

cautions.issue: Either white lane can strike its lower rubber and return out of control.
cautions.response: Test the lane once. Stop repeating it if the return reaches a slingshot, outlane, or the center gap.

cautions.issue: Shots at the lower-left drop targets have riskier returns than shots at the upper card drops.
cautions.response: Leave the lower targets for a near-complete hand or a proven glancing shot; use the left orbit otherwise.

cautions.issue: The center pad looks like a continuation of the completed bank but scores only 3,000.
cautions.response: Do not aim at the pad. Shoot the far-left 30,000 lane instead.

strategy.simpleOverview: Royal Flush Deluxe scores 30,000 repeatedly at the far-left white lane, while the riskier nine-card drop bank builds end-of-ball card bonus. Repeat the white lane from the right flipper, use its upper return for useful Joker lanes, and take card drops only when their rebounds are controlled.
strategy.overview: Royal Flush Deluxe scores 30,000 repeatedly at the far-left white lane, while its nine-card bank builds end-of-ball card bonus. Favor the white lane from the right flipper, collect Joker lanes through its upper return, and complete safe card drops when presented. Do not trade a controlled orbit shot for the exposed 3,000-point center pad.
